note: The label vocabulary of the twin: generic classes of loose things at a goods delivery site, each with a one-line description. Every unit label in objects.json must be one of these names, written exactly as here. Pick the class that describes the unit as a whole; 'other' only when no class fits. The list names more classes than the bay contains; it says nothing about which classes are present or how many of each. site_brief.md says which loose things are units.

descriptions.pallet_box: a pallet with stacked wooden collars (or a box built on a pallet), as one unit
descriptions.flat_pallet: a bare flat pallet of wood or plastic (stringer or block type)
descriptions.crate: a wooden crate or transport case that stands on its own, not on a pallet
descriptions.skip: an open-top steel waste skip of the kind a skip lorry lifts
descriptions.container: a large steel container with closed sides (goods, waste or a site container)
descriptions.wheelie_bin: a plastic or metal waste bin on wheels or castors, with a lid
descriptions.roll_container: a wire-mesh roll cage on castors
descriptions.drum: a cylindrical drum or barrel of steel or plastic
descriptions.bucket: a bucket, pail, tub or pot
descriptions.van: a panel van: cab and cargo space in one body
descriptions.box_truck: a light truck with a separate box body behind its cab
descriptions.flatbed_trailer: a road trailer with an open flat bed, its wheels and drawbar
descriptions.box_trailer: a road trailer with a closed box body
descriptions.trolley: a platform, board or sack trolley on wheels or castors
descriptions.timber_bundle: a stack or bundle of boards, beams or panels
descriptions.board: a single loose sheet or panel (plywood, chipboard, hardboard)
descriptions.sign_stand: a portable sign: a weighted base, a post and its sign plates
descriptions.barrier: a movable barrier element, barrier fence panel or barrier board
descriptions.traffic_cone: a traffic cone or delineator post
descriptions.tool_chest: a tool chest or tool cabinet on castors
descriptions.bag: a bag, sack or big bag
descriptions.cardboard: cardboard: a sheet, a flattened box or a carton
descriptions.other: a loose unit of no listed class
